name: build

on: [ push, pull_request ]

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '20.x'

      - name: Install Dependency
        run: yarn install

      - name: Run Lint
        run: yarn run lint


  test:
    needs: [ lint ]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        node: [ ^20 ]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: ${{ matrix.node }}

      - name: Install Dependency
        run: yarn install

      - name: Run Unit test
        run: yarn run test

# Manual release. Releases are cut by pushing a tag by hand:
#
#   vX.Y.Z-rcN  ->  GitHub *pre-release* only (the candidate to vote on)
#   vX.Y.Z      ->  GitHub release + publish to npm (after the vote passed)
#
# Both cases attach the same Apache source package. The release manager
# downloads it, signs it locally and takes it to the vote.

name: release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

permissions:
  contents: write

env:
  # Base name of the Apache source package, without version/suffix.
  ARTIFACT_PREFIX: apache-casbin-js

jobs:
  release:
    if: github.repository == 'apache/casbin-casbin.js'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Resolve version from tag
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TAG="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
          if [[ ! "${TAG}" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-rc[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::Tag '${TAG}' is not a release tag. Expected vX.Y.Z or vX.Y.Z-rcN."
            exit 1
          fi
          FULL="${TAG#v}"
          # The release candidate and the final release are the very same
          # artifact, so the -rcN suffix never appears in the package name.
          VERSION="${FULL%-rc*}"
          if [[ "${FULL}" == *-rc* ]]; then PRERELEASE=true; else PRERELEASE=false; fi
          echo "VERSION=${VERSION}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
          echo "PRERELEASE=${PRERELEASE}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
          echo "SRC_NAME=${ARTIFACT_PREFIX}-${VERSION}-incubating-src" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"

      - name: Build Apache source package
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git archive --format=tar.gz --prefix="${SRC_NAME}/" -o "${SRC_NAME}.tar.gz" HEAD
          sha512sum "${SRC_NAME}.tar.gz" > "${SRC_NAME}.tar.gz.sha512"

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20.x'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'

      - name: Install Dependency
        run: yarn install

      - name: Run Unit test
        run: yarn run test

      # An -rcN tag only ever produces a pre-release; the vote decides whether
      # it is promoted, which happens by pushing the matching vX.Y.Z tag.
      - name: Publish GitHub release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          FLAGS=""
          if [[ "${PRERELEASE}" == "true" ]]; then FLAGS="--prerelease"; fi
          gh release create "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" \
            --title "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}" \
            --generate-notes \
            ${FLAGS} \
            "${SRC_NAME}.tar.gz" "${SRC_NAME}.tar.gz.sha512"

      - name: Publish to npm
        if: env.PRERELEASE == 'false'
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          npm version "${VERSION}" --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version
          npm publish --access public
